tokyo_jujutsu_high.name: Tokyo Jujutsu High
tokyo_jujutsu_high.description: The prestigious school for jujutsu sorcerers, hidden within Tokyo.

courtyard.name: Main Courtyard
courtyard.description: An open training area surrounded by ancient buildings. Satoru Gojo often lounges here.

main_hall.name: Main Hall
main_hall.description: The central building where briefings and announcements take place. Principal Yaga's office is upstairs.

training_grounds.name: Training Grounds
training_grounds.description: A massive outdoor area with cursed barriers for combat practice. Cursed energy lingers in the air.

cursed_pit.name: Cursed Pit
cursed_pit.description: An underground arena where captured curses are held for training exercises. Rich with residual cursed energy.

dormitory.name: Student Dormitory
dormitory.description: Living quarters for students. Each room has personal cursed barriers for privacy.

cafeteria.name: Cafeteria
cafeteria.description: Serves food infused with mild cursed energy to help sorcerers recover. Gojo's favorite spot.

gate.name: Front Gate
gate.description: The barrier-protected entrance to Tokyo Jujutsu High. From here, the city awaits.

principals_office.name: Principal's Office
principals_office.description: Masamichi Yaga's office, cluttered with cursed corpse parts and documents. Serious business only.

shibuya_district.name: Shibuya District
shibuya_district.description: A bustling ward in Tokyo, teeming with civilians and hidden curses.

shibuya_intersection.name: Shibuya Crossing
shibuya_intersection.description: The famous scramble crossing. Beneath the crowds, a massive curtain of cursed energy pulses.

shibuya_station.name: Shibuya Station
shibuya_station.description: The transit hub where the Shibuya Incident occurred. Residual cursed energy still lingers intensely.

nightclub_alley.name: Nightclub Alley
nightclub_alley.description: Dark alleyways filled with bars and clubs. Cursed spirits prey on the intoxicated.

underground_mall.name: Underground Mall
underground_mall.description: An abandoned shopping complex beneath Shibuya. Curses have claimed it as their territory.

station_depths.name: Station Depths
station_depths.description: Deep beneath the station, sealed tunnels radiate cursed energy. Only the brave venture here.

veil_chamber.name: Veil Chamber
veil_chamber.description: A sealed room protected by a powerful veil. Powerful curses and rare materials await.

sakurajima_colony.name: Sakurajima Colony
sakurajima_colony.description: An isolated island colony governed by its own rules, where sorcerers battle for supremacy.

colony_dock.name: Colony Dock
colony_dock.description: The arrival point for the colony. A barrier separates it from the outside world.

colony_village.name: Colony Village
colony_village.description: A small settlement of civilians and weaker sorcerers. Trade happens here.

cliffside_mines.name: Cliffside Mines
cliffside_mines.description: Mineral-rich caves carved into the island cliffs. Cursed ores vein the walls.

deep_shaft.name: Deep Shaft
deep_shaft.description: The lowest level of the mines. Immense pressure and cursed energy create rare materials.

ancient_shrine.name: Ancient Shrine
ancient_shrine.description: A sacred site dating back centuries. The cursed energy here is old and powerful.

forest_path.name: Forest Path
forest_path.description: A winding path through cursed woods. Shadows move between the trees.

hidden_clearing.name: Hidden Clearing
hidden_clearing.description: A secret grove where cursed energy pools into liquid form. Extremely valuable materials.

jujutsu_high_kyoto.name: Kyoto Jujutsu High
jujutsu_high_kyoto.description: The rival branch of Jujutsu High, known for its traditional and militant approach.

kyoto_gate.name: Kyoto Gate
kyoto_gate.description: The imposing entrance to Kyoto Jujutsu High. More militaristic than Tokyo's.

kyoto_courtyard.name: Kyoto Courtyard
kyoto_courtyard.description: A disciplined training space. Kyoto students practice here constantly.

kyoto_arena.name: Kyoto Grand Arena
kyoto_arena.description: A massive arena for the Kyoto Sister-School Goodwill Event. Intense battles happen here.

kyoto_library.name: Cursed Archives
kyoto_library.description: Vast records of jujutsu history and techniques. Some scrolls hold forbidden knowledge.

sealed_vault.name: Sealed Vault
sealed_vault.description: A heavily protected underground vault containing dangerous cursed objects.
